item.title: EU's Deportation Drive Raises Human Rights Concerns Amid Systemic Pushbacks - EDN
item.description: The EU's intensified deportation policies, including fast-tracked asylum processes and 'return hubs,' face criticism for potential human rights violations, especially in light of Greece's systematic pushbacks.

item.title: Criminalising Care: What Europe Is Getting Wrong About Helping Migrants - EDN
item.description: From pre-trial detention to gendered threats, EDN breaks down the overlooked findings in PICUM’s 2024 report on how Europe is punishing those who help migrants.

item.title: Germany Targets Pro-Palestinian Protesters with Deportation: What It Means for Free Speech and Migrant Rights - EDN
item.description: Germany plans to deport four foreign nationals, including two EU citizens, over their role in a pro-Palestinian protest. The case raises serious legal questions about freedom of expression, migrant rights, and the use of immigration law in political dissent.

item.title: Germany Family Reunification Suspension: Legal Limits or Political Strategy?
item.description: Germany’s family reunification suspension for subsidiary protection sparks legal and human rights concerns. Is it lawful or just politics?

item.title: The EU’s Dangerous Expansion of the “Safe Third Country” Concept: Shifting Responsibility and Undermining Refugee Rights - EDN
item.description: The EU's 2024 proposal to expand the “Safe Third Country” concept risks violating refugee rights by allowing deportations to countries with poor protection standards. Critics warn it undermines asylum safeguards and shifts responsibility away from Europe.

item.title: MSF: Torture Widespread on Mediterranean Migration Routes - EDN
item.description: A new report by Doctors Without Borders reveals widespread torture against migrants in Libya and Tunisia. MSF calls for urgent EU policy change.

item.title: Austria Deportation to Syria Raises EU Asylum Concerns - EDN
item.description: Austria has deported a Syrian national, breaking EU asylum norms. EDN examines what this precedent means for refugee protection across Europe.

item.title: Germany Afghanistan Deportation Sparks Global Outcry
item.description: Germany Afghanistan deportation triggers global concern. EDN investigates UN objections, Taliban response, and rights violations after Kabul return flight.

item.title: Afghan Deportation -Psychiatric Deportation Criticized in Germany
item.description: Germany deported 3 Afghan psychiatric patients in July 2025. Human rights groups condemn the Afghan deportation from Germany as illegal and inhumane.

item.title: EU Returns Regulation: 9 Reasons Civil Society Demands Rejection
item.description: Civil society warns the EU Returns Regulation could enforce inhumane deportation rules. Rights groups say it undermines human rights and integration.
